role: Assistant Director, Office of State Planning & Development, Pennsylvania
stance_basis: letter explicitly states 'This Office does not wish to comment upon this statement'
summary: George Kasparek, Assistant Director of the Office of State Planning & Development for Pennsylvania, submitted a brief letter declining to comment on the draft environmental statement for Executive Order 11644 regarding off-road vehicles on public lands. He neither supported nor opposed the proposal, simply acknowledging receipt and declining to offer substantive comments.
complaint_summary: Kasparek's letter on behalf of the Pennsylvania Office of State Planning & Development declines to offer any comment on the draft environmental statement for the proposed implementation of Executive Order 11644 on off-road vehicles.

statement.text:
The Pennsylvania State Planning Board, also known as the Office of State Planning and Development, has received a copy of the draft environmental statement for Executive Order 11644 - use of offroad vehicles.
This Office does not wish to comment upon this statement.
Thank you for the opportunity to review this environmental statement.
Sincerely.
George Kasparek Assistant Director
Office of State Planning & Development
